code_summary: Four independently routed category models, each combining MultVAE and SASRec through equal-weight mean candidate ranks. MultVAE reconstructs unique binary histories using normalized inputs, a 256-unit hidden layer, 64-dimensional latent representation, dropout, and annealed KL regularization. SASRec uses length-50 sequences, 50-dimensional embeddings, two causal attention blocks, one head, and cross-entropy over one positive plus 16 sampled negatives. Training uses seed 42 and validation-based checkpoint selection. The generated predictor reloads both saved architectures and applies the same history preparation and rank fusion.
